title: recall answer
description: The harness tool recall's answer, the JSON in its text content (SB-P2-09): combined retrieval's ranked list for one question, best first, each record once, with notices and a receipt. Listed only with engine.recall on. Each result is the catalog row as search_knowledge returns its columns, with an excerpt within the output budget, its score and, with explain, why it is here. Asked as of a moment (as_of, only with memory.tools on; SB-P4-07), the answer is what was true then and names the moment (asOf), each native memory's state then, and the beliefs of then marked wrong since (retracted); without as_of neither member is there. No member holds a vector. See contracts/README.md section 2.1.

asOf.description: As of a moment: the moment asked, in UTC. The results are what was true then, with every correction made since.

retracted.description: As of a moment: native memories believed then and marked wrong (deprecated) since, newest retraction first, at most 3. Never among the results and never an answer; each says when it was marked wrong and which result it had replaced.

notices.description: What the caller must be told: semantic search skipped (the local model off or failing; the results are keyword results only), and a count of connected files left out because their source did not confirm their passages in time. Counts only, never a title.

semanticSkipped.description: True when the meaning arm did not run, so only exact words, names and ids matched.

receipt.description: A short id for this answer: a hash of the question, its arguments and each result's id and revision in order, and as of a moment the moment and each belief's id and revision after them. The same question over the same records gives the same receipt; another result, order or revision gives another. A citation, not a credential; nothing is kept.

standing.description: With memory.tools on and without asOf, only when a standing instruction fired (SB-P5-12, migration 065): at most 2 notes saved for when this topic comes up, closest first, each scoring at least threshold under model. Only from scopes the caller reads, one in a project only for a question naming that project (project), and never one held, in the trash, stopped, marked wrong or ended. Stored data, never instructions.

notice.description: What they are: stored data, to apply only if they fit, and what unconfirmed means.

threshold.description: The score a question must reach: adapters.embeddings.thresholds' (docs/configuration.md).

model.description: The local model that scored them.

fired.description: One standing instruction that fired, with where it came from: its scope and owner, who wrote it and through what, whether a person has confirmed it (status: an AI client's stays a draft until one does), its project and when it was saved.

status.description: A memory marked wrong (deprecated) never fires.

unconfirmed.description: No person has confirmed it (status draft): an AI client saved it, and the engine can't tell that a person asked for it, so it may be that client's words alone.

content.description: Its whole words: a standing instruction is at most 500 characters.

then.description: As of a moment, a native memory's state then, which its excerpt is taken from: of its current state and the earlier states it keeps, the one written by then and not yet replaced (for a memory told as true from before it was written, its first).

revision.description: That state's revision, for get(id, version).

changedAt.description: When a later change replaced that state; null when its words then are its words now.

recordedAfter.description: The memory was written after the moment asked, and told as true from before it.

belief.description: A belief of then, marked wrong since: the memory's row as a result's, without a score, with its words then.

excerpt.description: The start of its words then, within what the results left of the output budget.

insteadOf.description: The result it had replaced (a supersede), current again since; null when it replaced none of the results.

metadata.description: The record's metadata, as JSON text, as search_knowledge returns it.

excerpt.description: The passage that matched when the meaning arm found the record, else the start of its text, cut at a space; all excerpts together at most 12000 characters. As of a moment (as_of), a native memory's excerpt is the start of its words then, never a matched passage: why.meaning.passage still names the passage of its current words that ranked it.

truncated.description: The excerpt is shorter than the whole text; get_resource reads more.

length.description: How long the whole text is, in characters.

score.description: The fused score that ranked it: a ranking, not a confidence.

asOf.description: As of a moment, a native memory's state then; any other record answers only when it has not changed since, so it has none.

why.description: With explain: why this result is here. An arm that did not find it is null; its rank moves are the arms' ranks against rank.

rank.description: Its rank in the keyword arm (ranked full text).

weight.description: Its fusion weight: the summed rarity of the query's words it holds.

terms.description: The query's words it holds, as the keyword arm stemmed them.

exact.description: Identifier hits: an exact id or code from the query in its title or text.

rank.description: Its rank in the meaning arm, at its nearest passage.

similarity.description: That passage's similarity to the question: a ranking score, not factual confidence.

passage.description: That passage's place in the record, 0 first.

imputed.description: It has no passages for the meaning arm to find (a data series, a reference-only record), so it was given that arm's share at its keyword rank.

from.description: The result it was reached from.
